lines.text: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat went up to Ramoth-gilead, and the king of Israel disguised himself for battle.
The king of Aram ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders to fight only the king of Judah.
A man drew his bow without special aim and struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor.
The battle raged all day, and the king died that morning and was brought to Samaria.
The dogs licked up Ahab's blood at the pool of Samaria, and his son Ahaziah reigned in his place.
